components.name: DynamicIsland
components.purpose: Fixed top ambient glow bar simulating iPhone Dynamic Island — breathing animation, 4 theme color variants, safe-area-inset aware.
components.visual_style: Dark pill, layered box-shadow glow in 3 radii, 4s breathing keyframe. Sits above all content, pointerEvents none.
components.interaction_style: Purely decorative. No click target. Responds to themeColor prop.
components.verdict: Best piece in the repo. Drop-in ambient status indicator. Add more theme variants and ship it.

components.name: EntityCard
components.purpose: Selectable card for a named entity — emoji icon, title, description; three visual states (default / active / special).
components.visual_style: Dark rounded-xl card, border-2, amber highlight on active, white highlight on special variant. Lift on hover.
components.interaction_style: Single click, no keyboard handling. Active state controlled by parent.
components.verdict: Cleanest component in the repo. 25 lines, zero deps beyond React. Perfect card primitive.

components.name: SafeComponents
components.purpose: XSS defense kit — escapeHtml, SafeLink (protocol blocklist), SafeHtml (DOMPurify wrapper), SafeUserContent.
components.visual_style: Minimal. SafeLink shows strikethrough + warning emoji on blocked URLs.
components.verdict: Production-grade. Ship as standalone security utility.

components.name: CommandCenter
components.purpose: Primary navigation hub — 40 portal cards, breathing cosmos background, floating DOM particles, Konami code easter egg, Ghost Mode overlay.
components.visual_style: Deep #0a0515 base. Radial gradient breathing animation. Frosted cards with backdrop-filter blur. Card lift + fire-orange glow on hover.
components.interaction_style: Card click navigates (300ms delay). onTouchStart/End scale to 0.97. Konami code triggers 10s Ghost Mode.
risk_flags: DOM particle injection bypasses React lifecycle
components.verdict: Card hover pattern is the best visual interaction here. 40-portal flat dump is the worst UX decision.

components.name: ZlatiKrog
components.purpose: Golden Circle portal — 5 entity cards, concentric rotating rings, clickable heartbeat speed toggle, RESNICA modal progressive reveal.
components.visual_style: Three concentric border rings with different spin speeds (requires custom Tailwind animate). Amber #f59e0b palette. RESNICA modal: dark full-screen with confidence-graded evidence sections.
components.interaction_style: Heartbeat click toggles pulse speed. Entity click selects card. RESNICA opens text-wall modal.
risk_flags: RESNICA modal is a text wall
animate-spin-slow not in Tailwind core (requires plugin or custom config)
components.verdict: Orbit ring + pulsing center is a genuine UI jewel. Extract the animation concept, not the component.

components.name: AstralSonicPortal
components.purpose: 6-agent frequency portal using Web Audio API. CSS circular sigil layout. Central flame triggers full harmony playback. Consciousness stream log.
components.visual_style: Radial gradient dark background. Gradient clip text header. Colored agent sigils with glow matching --agent-color. Stream log with left-border accent.
components.interaction_style: Click agent sigil → play sine oscillator at Hz. Click central flame → staggered all-agent playback. Toggle sound stops all oscillators.
risk_flags: potential oscillator memory leak if cleanup fails
fixed-size wheel may clip on iPhone SE (375px)
components.verdict: CSS-only circular orbit layout + Web Audio frequency triggers = rare interaction novelty. Extract both patterns.

components.name: OrionDashboard
components.purpose: 6-tab environmental analysis dashboard — Leaflet map, EHI scoring, timeline, network graph, legal actions, EU finance flows.
components.visual_style: Dark slate palette. Lucide icons. Color-coded EHI markers (red >0.7 / amber >0.4 / green). Tab strip with active border-bottom.
components.interaction_style: Tab switching. Map marker click → site detail panel. AI chat modal open/close.
components.verdict: Too married to domain data. Tab strip and EHI colored dot patterns worth lifting. Never use as-is.

components.name: AIAnalystModal
components.purpose: Slide-over chat modal for querying Gemini LLM about environmental data. Mock fallback mode. Auto-scroll, typing indicator, context-aware prompting.
components.visual_style: Full-screen overlay. AI bubbles left-aligned purple, user bubbles right-aligned slate. Typing dots animated.
components.interaction_style: Enter or Send button submits. useRef auto-scrolls to latest message. X button closes.
best_reuse_target: Ghostline (as general contextual AI chat widget)
components.verdict: Clean chat modal. Graceful mock fallback. The context payload builder pattern is worth generalizing.

components.name: FinanceFlowsModule
components.purpose: EU climate finance visualization vs Sava contamination. Bar charts (Recharts), expandable accordion sections.
components.visual_style: Dark card containers. Recharts with custom colors. Expandable sections.
components.interaction_style: Accordion toggle. Chart hover tooltips via Recharts defaults.
components.verdict: Too domain-specific. Accordion-chart pattern is worth noting.

components.name: MorningPortal
components.purpose: Daily greeting portal — 10 AI 'Decad' members with 4 rotating greetings each. Live clock. Tab navigation (Greetings / Docs / Updates). Search filter.
components.visual_style: Green-accented (unique theme among views). Warm greeting cards.
components.interaction_style: Tab switch. 1-second clock tick via setInterval. String search filters visible content.
components.verdict: Clean daily-orientation UX. Morning context + live clock + quick-tab docs access is worth stealing.

components.name: App (Router)
components.purpose: Root component — hash-based view router, global DynamicIsland, global back button with safe-area positioning. 24+ view conditionals.
components.visual_style: Back button: Tailwind slate-800 bg, slate-400 text. DynamicIsland global.
components.interaction_style: hashchange listener drives view state. Theme color derived from view string. No lazy loading.
risk_flags: no lazy loading (all 24 components imported at startup)
components.verdict: Elegant zero-dependency SPA router. Add React.lazy() and this becomes production-worthy.

components.name: iOS PWA Reset (index.css)
components.purpose: Safe-area-insets, -webkit-fill-available height fix, overscroll-behavior none, 16px input font-size to prevent iOS zoom. Orphaned .ritual-recipes styles.
components.verdict: The iOS PWA block is production-ready. Copy verbatim into any mobile-first project. Remove orphaned recipe styles.

best_low_entropy_interactions.note: Direct mapping: tap circle → play frequency
One action → staggered cascade of all agents

Progressive disclosure: click the right card
Hidden layer revealed by gesture sequence

things_to_avoid.impact: Bypasses React lifecycle, leaks on remount

things_to_avoid.antipattern: Localhost external links in a deployed app
things_to_avoid.impact: Breaks for everyone who isn't the author
7 dense sections in a modal — should be its own page
Full bundle on first load regardless of landing view

things_to_avoid.antipattern: Mixed styling systems with no clear rule
things_to_avoid.impact: Tailwind + inline styles + CSS files — maintenance debt

what_feels_alive: DynamicIsland — genuine ambient UI, most original interaction in the repo
EntityCard — 25 lines of pure component design, nothing wasted
AstralSonicPortal orbit layout — CSS rotate-translate-counter-rotate, real interaction novelty
Hash router in App.jsx — zero dependencies, 50 lines, full SPA routing
Card hover pattern in CommandCenter — translateY + border fire-orange + spring cubic-bezier
iOS PWA handling — thorough safe-area-insets, -webkit-fill-available, all iOS edge cases
fake_complexity: 40 portals on one screen — anxiety made visible, not rich ecosystem
RESNICA modal — a research paper forced into a modal
DOM particle system — 25 createElement calls in a React component
6 simultaneous animation loops in CommandCenter — exhausting, not atmospheric
Consciousness stream showing only interaction-triggered messages — grows into noise if expanded
never_reuse: FinanceFlowsModule as-is — static Slovenian environmental data, not portable
OrionDashboard as a whole — 946 lines, hardcoded coordinates, domain-specific
Localhost external links — not features, bugs in a deployed app
DOM particle injection pattern — fragile, leaks, fights React
Duplicate-sphere-ID pattern — silent key collision risk
safest_next_steps: Extract DynamicIsland — rename theme to hex/CSS var, add label prop, ship to Ghostline
Extract EntityCard — generalize special variant to a prop (variant: default|active|special)
Extract SafeComponents — copy as standalone utility with dompurify dep
Copy iOS PWA reset block from index.css into every mobile-first project
Adopt hash router pattern for small React SPAs, add React.lazy() for view imports
Steal card hover pattern from CommandCenter — cubic-bezier spring + fire-orange border + shadow
Study getContextualPayload in AIAnalystModal for domain-aware AI chat widget pattern
